description:
Activate Scion of the Swarm by using Walking Ballista's ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life due to its lifelink.
Scion of the Swarm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Scion of the Swarm
uses.cardState: with a +1/+1 counter on it and has lifelink
